name: Dr. Tunde Samuel Omisore
paragraphs: Dr. Tunde Samuel Omisore is an experienced Family Physician with over 14 years of clinical experience across Canada, the United Kingdom, and Nigeria. He is a Certificant of the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CCFP) and a Member of the Royal College of General Practitioners in the United Kingdom (MRCGP).

Dr. Omisore has extensive experience providing comprehensive, patient-centred care to individuals and families across all stages of life. His clinical interests include preventive medicine, chronic disease management, acute care, men's and women's health, paediatrics, geriatrics, and mental health.

Throughout his career, Dr. Omisore has worked in a variety of healthcare settings, including community family practice, urgent and emergency care, hospital medicine, and tertiary teaching hospitals. This broad experience has strengthened his ability to manage both common and complex medical conditions while working collaboratively with specialists and other healthcare professionals.

In addition to comprehensive family medicine, Dr. Omisore has developed a range of office-based procedural and minor surgical skills. These include joint injections, cryotherapy, ear syringing, IUD insertion and removal, contraceptive implant (Implanon/Nexplanon) insertion and removal, and minor surgical procedures such as shave and excisional biopsies.

Dr. Omisore is committed to building strong, trusting relationships with his patients and believes in providing compassionate, respectful, and individualized care. He takes a holistic approach to medicine and works collaboratively with patients to support their health and wellbeing.

Dr. Omisore is excited to join Valleyview Medical Centre in Brantford, Ontario, where he looks forward to becoming part of the local healthcare community and providing comprehensive, compassionate family medicine to patients and families in the Brantford area.
Outside his clinical practice, Dr. Omisore has a strong interest in preventive healthcare, quality improvement, medical education, mentorship, and continuous professional development.

name: Dr. Kolawole Gbolagade
paragraphs: Dr. Kolawole Gbolagade is a highly skilled family physician with over 14 years of cumulative clinical experience. He graduated from Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife, and qualified as a medical doctor in 2012. He subsequently completed his training and qualified as a Family Physician in the United Kingdom in 2020.

Since April 2025, Dr. Gbolagade has been practicing as a Family Physician in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated a strong commitment to patient-centred care, continuous professional development, and the delivery of holistic, evidence-based medical care. His extensive clinical experience and dedication to advancing his knowledge enable him to provide comprehensive care tailored to the individual needs of his patients.

name: Dr. Eseigbe Uwadia
paragraphs: Dr. Eseigbe Uwadia is an experienced Family Physician with over a decade of medical practice across Nigeria and the United Kingdom. He is passionate about providing compassionate, comprehensive and patient-centred care to individuals and families at every stage of life.

Dr. Uwadia completed medical school in Nigeria before moving to the United Kingdom, where he undertook specialist training in General Practice and obtained his MRCGP and Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT). He also holds Certification in the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CCFP).

His broad clinical experience includes community family practice, adult and paediatric emergency medicine, urgent care, community psychiatry, care of older adults, and pre- and post-operative care. This diverse experience has given him a well-rounded approach to caring for patients with both acute concerns and ongoing or complex health needs.

His clinical interests include preventive healthcare and screening, chronic disease management, mental health, care of older adults, urgent medical concerns and medication management. He strongly believes in continuity of care and shared decision-making, taking time to understand each patient's individual concerns, priorities and circumstances.

Dr. Uwadia is delighted to join the Peterborough community and looks forward to caring for individuals and families from diverse backgrounds. He aims to build trusted, long-term relationships with his patients and create a welcoming environment where they feel heard, respected and involved in their care.

His approach to Family Medicine is centred on a simple principle: listen carefully, treat the whole person, prevent illness where possible, and work together with patients toward better health and quality of life.

name: Dr. Babajide Olawale Odusan
paragraphs: Dr. Babajide Olawale Odusan is an experienced Family Physician with a strong background in General Practice and Internal Medicine in the United Kingdom. He earned his Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery degree from Obafemi Awolowo University before relocating to the United Kingdom to further his postgraduate medical training and clinical career.

Dr. Odusan completed his GP Specialty Training through the Durham and Tees Valley GP Specialty Training Programme, where he gained extensive multidisciplinary experience across Mental Health, Paediatrics, Emergency Medicine, and Community Family Practice. During his training and subsequent clinical work, he developed a patient-centred approach focused on evidence-based medicine, continuity of care, and preventive health management.

In addition to his work in Family Medicine, Dr. Odusan has served as a Medical Registrar in the Department of Internal Medicine within the NHS, managing a broad range of acute and chronic medical conditions in hospital settings. His background in Internal Medicine has strengthened his expertise in complex patient care, chronic disease management, and collaborative multidisciplinary practice.

Dr. Odusan has worked across multiple hospitals and family practice clinics throughout Northern England, providing comprehensive care to diverse patient populations. His clinical interests include preventive medicine, chronic disease management, mental health, acute care medicine, and holistic family healthcare.

He is a Member of the Royal College of General Practitioners and is also a certificant of the College of Family Physicians of Canada. Dr. Odusan remains committed to delivering compassionate, high-quality, and accessible healthcare while supporting the wellbeing of individuals and families within the community.

name: Dr. Henry Oghotuoma
paragraphs: Dr. Henry Oghotuoma, MBBS, MRCGP, CCFP, is an experienced Family Physician with a strong background in General Practice within the United Kingdom. He earned his medical degree in Nigeria before relocating to the UK to undertake postgraduate medical training and advance his clinical career.

He completed his GP Specialty Training through the Durham and Tees Valley GP Specialty Training Programme, where he gained extensive multidisciplinary experience across Geriatric Medicine, Paediatrics, Emergency Medicine, and Community Family Practice. Through both his training and clinical practice, Dr. Oghotuoma has developed a patient-centred approach rooted in evidence-based medicine, continuity of care, preventive healthcare, and holistic family medicine.

In addition to his work in General Practice, Dr. Oghotuoma served as a Senior House Officer in Orthopaedic Surgery within the NHS. This role enhanced his expertise in acute clinical assessment, musculoskeletal medicine, postoperative management, multidisciplinary teamwork, and the care of patients with complex medical and surgical needs across both hospital and community settings.

Dr. Oghotuoma has worked across several hospitals and GP practices throughout Northern England, providing comprehensive care to diverse patient populations. His clinical interests include preventive medicine, chronic disease management, paediatrics, elderly care, musculoskeletal medicine, mental health, acute care medicine, and holistic family healthcare.

He is a Member of the Royal College of General Practitioners (MRCGP) and a certificant of the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CCFP). Dr. Oghotuoma remains committed to delivering compassionate, high-quality, and accessible healthcare while supporting the wellbeing of individuals and families within the community.
